What is hyprshade?

Hyprshade is a command-line tool that manages Hyprland's built-in screen-shader feature, letting you turn visual filters like a blue-light-reduction warm filter on or off, or switch between them automatically based on time of day. It's meant as a Wayland-native replacement for older tools like Redshift or f.lux, and comes with a default blue-light shader plus support for custom GLSL shaders and systemd-based scheduling.

Install hyprshade on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add hyprshade

Good to know

  • Hyprland window manager with screen_shader support
  • systemd (only if using the scheduling/auto feature)
